gitActions: no new worktree, commit, push, tag or release

windowsUpgrade.scope: Windows native in-place rebrand, isolated legacy data and WebView profile
checks: caller identity and owner capability preserved
old waiting/answered/cancelled/expired/erased tasks preserve authority and original answers
original idempotency keys still deduplicate or remain tombstoned
provider configuration, route edges and lifecycle commands unchanged
old language/theme/scale/status-bar preferences preserved
new native decision desk answers the old pending task; original caller retrieves its result
same 64-byte encryption/owner key, legacy data directory and WebView storage reused without copying or clearing
a second new-app restart retains the answer made after upgrade

androidUpgrade.scope: old signed M1 APK -> SysTorch in-place update on isolated Android API 35 emulator
checks: explicit old gateway stop survives upgrade; native RPC starts the new daemon without an HTTP gateway dependency
caller identity and owner capability preserved
old waiting/answered/cancelled/expired/erased tasks preserve authority and original answers
original idempotency keys still deduplicate or remain tombstoned
provider configuration, route edges and lifecycle commands unchanged
old language/theme/scale/status-bar preferences preserved
new native decision desk answers the old pending task; original caller retrieves its result
same installed application ID, signer-compatible install -r and application UID; no data clearing during upgrade
legacy launcher and foreground-service component identities resolve through new SysTorch implementations
a second cold restart retains the answer accepted after upgrade
notification/tile intents work on Start and Routing without mounting Dashboard and do not replay on navigation
a cold-start notification/tile gesture is accepted once; reloading the UI does not replay it
androidUpgrade.inputScope: native WebView UI at 100%; 137% preference preservation asserted before changing test view scale; native zoomed input remains unverified

externalChoice.scope: selected M1 candidate EXE, native human answer, two independent PowerShell 5.1 callers
checks: first PowerShell 5.1 process exits after durable acceptance; receipt contains no token
re-running Submit reuses the exact persisted idempotency key and task
independent pre-answer query reports pending without cancellation
native owner decision desk answers the task while no caller process is alive
fresh PowerShell 5.1 query retrieves the strict result with the same caller token

http.scope: isolated daemon, real HTTP/SQLite and Chromium, synthetic choices only
checks: explicit identity required even on local loopback
caller task isolation and admin role does not imply answer permission
interleaved requests from two callers retain separate ownership and answers
a pending human task does not block the existing immediate model/DAG path
20 duplicate submissions are the same durable task; changed body conflicts
pending survives actual process exit and restart with stable caller/owner
20 concurrent conflicting answers select exactly one authoritative observation and strict result
completed result survives a second real restart without executing any upstream
caller-only revision, responder clarification, stale answer rejection and conditional projection stop
refusal, cancellation, erasure and persistent no-replay tombstones
wall-clock expiry is enforced before any late answer
IME and offline submission preserve the draft without reporting an authoritative answer
real UI submit → navigate draft → answer → caller result → refresh recovery at 1440px
real UI submit → navigate draft → answer → caller result → refresh recovery at 1024px
real UI submit → navigate draft → answer → caller result → refresh recovery at 390px
real UI submit → navigate draft → answer → caller result → refresh recovery at 360px
browser caller identity is reused by Choice/model APIs; readonly UI hides provider management and Choice denies unassigned answers
offline data-directory backup with owner key restores durable authority
missing/mismatched owner key blocks Choice acceptance without crashing the old model gateway; restoring the key recovers results
no fixture body, answer or credential plaintext in database or daemon logs

limitations: Windows EXE has no Authenticode signature
Android native upgrade/launch intents tested on isolated API 35 x86_64 emulator; ARM64 APK built, signed and inspected but no physical ARM device test
Android UI input tested at 100%; 137% preference preservation verified; native high-zoom touch not accepted
No formal installer/stable-key APK, CI, Docker or public-site migration run
Logo is a handoff-based candidate; visual recognition and final aesthetic acceptance belong to the maintainer
